heraliz_ping.roue.rappel: Release to mark · right click: cancel
heraliz_ping.msg.cadence: Easy: too many pings at once.
heraliz_ping.msg.portee: Too far to mark (%s blocks at most).
heraliz_ping.msg.carte: Pings from the map are turned off on this server.
heraliz_ping.cmd.aide.bref: Tap the key: marks what you aim at (the type is picked for you: loot, enemy, let's go).
heraliz_ping.cmd.aide.roue: Hold the key: the wheel opens. Point at a type with the mouse, release to mark.
heraliz_ping.cmd.aide.annuler: Tap on one of your own pings: it goes away.
heraliz_ping.cmd.aide.qui: Only your channel sees your pings: your clan by default (your team in a match).
heraliz_ping.cmd.aide.touche: Default key: front side mouse button. Change it in Options > Controls > HeraliZ Ping.
heraliz_ping.cmd.aide.canal: /ping canal <name>: separate channel (to play with players outside your clan) · /ping canal: see yours · /ping canal clan: back to your clan.
heraliz_ping.canal.voir.canal: Your ping channel: "%s" (%s online: %s). /ping canal clan to go back to your clan.
heraliz_ping.canal.voir.clan: Your ping channel: your clan %s. /ping canal <name> for a separate channel.
heraliz_ping.canal.voir.seul: Your ping channel: none (without a clan, only you see your pings). /ping canal <name> to join a channel.
heraliz_ping.canal.nom: Invalid channel name: 2 to 16 letters or digits, no spaces ("clan" is reserved).
heraliz_ping.canal.deja: You are already on this channel.
heraliz_ping.canal.attente: Wait a moment before changing channel.
heraliz_ping.canal.plein: This channel already has %s players online.
heraliz_ping.canal.rejoint: Ping channel: "%s". Only players on this channel see your pings, and you see theirs (%s online).
heraliz_ping.canal.retour_clan: Ping channel: back to your clan %s.
heraliz_ping.canal.retour_seul: Ping channel: back to the clan channel (without a clan, only you see your pings).

heraliz_ping.cmd.admin.stats: %s pings received, %s relayed (%s packets sent), %s active, %s µs per ping on average
heraliz_ping.cmd.admin.refus: Refused: rate %s · range %s · out of sight %s · target %s · spectator %s
